t: Human-AI Collaboration: Mastering Data Workflows with REPL & K-Means
s: This article details a pragmatic approach to data workflow development, emphasizing iterative 'Step 1' development and human-AI synergy. It demystifies K-Means clustering and showcases efficient data truncation for resource management before complex processing.
sub: Demystifying K-Means Clustering ('k' as arbitrary, 'means' as centroid)
Resource Management via Data Truncation for Efficiency
Interactive REPL for Debugging and Validation
